name: Solution Consideration
description: Forms, for any solution, the prompt a pass of AI reads to judge a matter against that solution's own records, from the network of records connected to it, so a solution's memory is never skipped and nothing is written per solution.
purpose: Give each relevant solution its own consideration, with a prompt formed from the records it connects to, for any pass of AI that judges work against it.
approach: Gather the records connected to a solution, weight each by the kind of edge that connects it, fill a size budget with the closest and most decision-relevant records first, and offer its knowledge items for the situation to choose from.
out_of_scope: Calling a model or judging the matter, which the caller does with one pass per prompt; deciding which solutions a text concerns (Solution Relevance does that); finding records for a request (Spec Search does that).
milestones: 1. Solution consideration, free stage: every case passes for the network arm and the definition_only baseline misses the cases whose deciding record is held only in the network (metric-solution-consideration). 2. One real case: a cheap model given the generated prompt reaches the verdict the records support where the same model given the solution's record alone does not.
knowledge: Each solution is an area that deserves its own depth of focus, and each level of a hierarchy is a different scope with its own value, such as the structure of the combination of its children (the author's pattern 16, Each solution gets its own consideration). The case that motivated it: a single pass triaging many outside repositories rated a graph tool strongest while its arm had already lost clearly on the solution's own cases, a loss held only in the results log and a finding. Progressive disclosure by tiers, as the specification index reads records. Edges differ in what they carry: a parent gives the scope above, children and dependencies an interface, dependents what they rely on.
measures_of_success: A pass given the prompt reaches the verdict the records support on cases where the deciding record is held only in the network; every relevant record of the solution fits the budget before any connected one.
parameters: budget (characters, from [consider] budget, else 24000); task, the matter to consider; extra record files ([[consider.records]] in the configuration, or --with on the command line); whether to judge which results describe older code.
inputs: A repository's records, its results log, its public evidence and declared finding files; a solution id; the matter to consider.
outputs: The prompt text, and as data its sections by tier, what the budget cut, the parent and children, and a digest of the text.
effects: Reads the records, the results log and git history to tell which results describe older code; writes nothing.
usage_notes: `esoi spec prompt SOLUTION` prints one prompt; `esoi consider TEXT` returns one per relevant solution and per parent level as JSON for a caller to run one pass each. Declare finding and candidate files in [[consider.records]], which rule S60 then checks. See docs/how-to/give-each-solution-its-own-consideration.md. Knowledge items live in knowledge.csv beside problems.csv (`esoi knowledge add|list|migrate|cards`); `--knowledge candidates` (the default) returns them beside the prompt for the caller's retrieval or card store, `ranked` writes them in, rule S61 keeps them sourced and current.
